facts.fact: allAfrica reports that the SGF land management system, contracted to ModelSis in December 2023 for an 18-month build, will include an electronic signature mechanism among its modules.

SEN.note: Document does not address an electronic transactions law.
A public portal is only a planned SGF module; the UN index score is not a service count.

facts.fact: allAfrica reports the DGID awarded the contract for the SGF, an integrated land management platform with a cadastral GIS module, to ModelSis in December 2023 for an 18-month build, and describes it as still in gestation in December 2025.

SEN.note: Interconnecting the central and territorial levels is only an ambition; no local office connection is stated.
